==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in an indoor, rocky, chamber. There are two other guys there with me. One of the guys wore monk robes and the other dressed in business casual.

The man in the monk robes leaped to the top of a tall, rocky incline in a single jump. The business casual man seemingly did the same thing. But I could tell that the business casual man was actually using an illusion.

When I realized the monk wasn't able to see through the illusion, I determined that the monk couldn't see energy that well. While I can't jump to the top of the incline in a single leap, I can see auras better than either of them. This is my gift.
